forbidden.name: no-circular
forbidden.comment: Modules form a directed graph; a cycle couples every module on it.

forbidden.name: no-orphans
forbidden.comment: Every production source is reachable from an entry point or removed.

forbidden.name: production-not-to-dev-dependencies
forbidden.comment: Installed users receive only runtime dependencies.

forbidden.name: generated-only-through-schema
forbidden.comment: Generated validators are an implementation detail of the schema module.

forbidden.name: module-interface
forbidden.comment: A module's index.ts is its interface; other modules must not reach past it.

forbidden.name: root-module-interface
forbidden.comment: Top-level sources use a module only through its index.ts.

forbidden.name: consumer-module-interface
forbidden.comment: Tests, tooling and examples cross the same seam as production callers.

forbidden.name: layer-base
forbidden.comment: Base modules depend on nothing above them.

forbidden.name: layer-infrastructure
forbidden.comment: Workspace, runtime, isolation and hooks do not depend on features, evaluation, the CLI or entry points.

forbidden.name: layer-infrastructure-order
forbidden.comment: Within infrastructure, workspace sits below runtime, which sits below isolation, which sits below hooks.

forbidden.name: layer-workspace
forbidden.comment: Workspace ownership is the lowest infrastructure module.

forbidden.name: layer-features
forbidden.comment: Feature modules do not depend on evaluation orchestration, the CLI or entry points.

forbidden.name: layer-evaluation
forbidden.comment: Evaluation orchestration does not depend on the CLI or entry points.

forbidden.name: layer-cli
forbidden.comment: The CLI does not depend on entry points.
